Priya Nair: Quick heads-up — Lattice Retail POC update. Their Prod org wants to spin up two new squads (Localization + Search) starting next sprint. They asked for: 1) embeddings quota bump (~3x) 2) routing + data residency in EU 3) a private deployment eval for PII workflows. Also dropped a hint about consolidation at renewal. Need CS + AE + Eng-Infra alignment. Any immediate blockers?

Marco Diaz: Thanks Priya. @Ethan can you confirm rough lead times and cost delta for EU Dedicated vs Private? Renewal is in Oct so this could influence their decision.

Ethan Cole: We can offer an EU Dedicated pilot (equivalent to ~4x A100 capacity) and soft-route traffic now. Dedicated provisioning ETA ~3 weeks; Private (on-prem/VPC with HSM) is 4-6 weeks because of KMS work. I'll draft two options and a cost sim. For immediate cost wins suggest enabling sequence-aware batching + prefix caching — ask them for a representative workload sample.

Priya Nair: Sharing their sample prompts now — they mostly do short extract+embed flows and some summarization. Paste: ```
# example 1 - summarization
User: "Summarize this product doc for EU catalog"
System: "Trim to 3 bullets, keep compliance notes"

# example 2 - embedding lookup
Query: "red winter coat, size 10"
TopK: 10

# example 3 - rerank
Input: 50 candidates, prefer recency and location proximity
```

Leo Zhang: On infra: EU routing and regional endpoints are fine. Private deployment requiring HSM/KMS integration is the longer pole — estimate 4-6 weeks for full compliance sign-off. For throughput, we can approve a temporary quota uplift while Dedicated is provisioned. Need Eng-Sec sign-off for residency + key handling.

Marco Diaz: OK. Proposal: offer a 6-week Dedicated EU pilot with SLA-backed latency targets and a parallel Private eval track. @Priya capture expected qps and daily tokens so Ethan can size. Also flag renewal as higher priority.

Priya Nair: They expect a daytime spike ~250 qps for embedding lookups (peak), baseline ~40 qps. Generation volume ~2M tokens/day. Latency requirement: <120ms for most lookup paths. Logging these in Gainsight and I'll attach the playbook notes.

Ethan Cole: Got it — I'll run a cost sim and include batching configs to hit cost targets. @deploy-bot please kick off the temporary quota increase request for embeddings and EU routing.

deploy-bot: Quota increase request submitted: ticket CS-7894. Estimated completion: 48 hours. :white_check_mark:

Priya Nair: Thanks — I'll schedule an enablement workshop with the Localization lead and get their sample telemetry. Also capturing feedback: devs said anything over 120ms for embedding lookups and they're worried about vendor consolidation if SLA not met.

Marco Diaz: Noted. Mark renewal health as at-risk until pilot proves latency <120ms. Priya, set a 2-week sync and we'll review pilot KPIs then. :eyes:
